digest.component_or_area: plan review coaching moves and criteria
propositions: A plan review criterion and coaching move must detect when source-code reference inventories are enumerated by hand or incompletely rather than derived from the symbol graph.
The criterion must route to plan_review only, not code_review, because code-review applies_when vocabularies are closed and project.* ids cannot fire in that gate.
The coaching move template must direct re-derivation using find_referencing_symbols AND the string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) that the LSP cannot resolve.
The criterion posture must be advisory via default_posture without blocking_enabled, because it coaches method not correctness.
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is required.
Detection fires reliably on incomplete hand-enumerated inventories at agent tier with validity 1.0, but coaching move selection is LLM-controlled and cannot be guaranteed through configuration alone.
